config.jade.display_tooltip.tooltip: The global switch to enable or disable the tooltip.
config.jade.display_bosses.tooltip: Describe the Ender Dragon and the Wither.
config.jade.display_blocks.tooltip: Describe the block under the crosshair.
config.jade.fluid_mode.tooltip: Any: fluids are targets. None: never. Fallback: only when no block is hit.
config.jade.display_mode.tooltip: Toggle: the Show Overlay key turns it on and off. Hold: shown while the key is held. Lite: only the main lines, the rest with Show Details held.
config.jade.item_mod_name.tooltip: Show which mod is an item from on its tooltip. The port has no item tooltip hook; this option does nothing.
config.jade.hide_from_guis.tooltip: Hide the tooltip on most GUI displays.
config.jade.boss_bar_overlap_mode.toolti: What to do when a boss bar is where the tooltip goes. Push Down Tooltip: put the tooltip below the bars. Hide Tooltip: hide the tooltip. Hide Boss Bar: hide the bars it covers.
config.jade.extended_reach.tooltip: Increase the distance limit to the target.
config.jade.perspective_mode.tooltip: Whether the ray starts at the camera or at the eye.
config.jade.debug.tooltip: Jade's dev switch. The port's debug switch is the JADE_DEBUG=1 environment variable; this option does nothing.
config.jade.builtin_camouflage.tooltip: Jade swaps disguised blocks (infested, powder snow, suspicious gravel). The port has no block-swap hook; this option does nothing.
config.jade.hide_from_tab_list.tooltip: Hide the tooltip when displaying the player list.
config.jade.overlay_pos_x.tooltip: Where the tooltip sits across the screen, 0 left to 1 right.
config.jade.overlay_pos_y.tooltip: Where the tooltip sits up the screen, 0 bottom to 1 top.
config.jade.overlay_anchor_x.tooltip: Which point of the box sits at the position, across.
config.jade.overlay_anchor_y.tooltip: Which point of the box sits at the position, down.
config.jade.auto_scale_threshold.tooltip: A tooltip taller than this share of the screen is shrunk.
config.jade.animation.tooltip: Animate the overlay when it appears and disappears. Morph the box when size changes.
config.jade.disappearing_delay.tooltip: Ticks (1/20 s) the tooltip stays after you look away.
config.jade.flip_main_hand.tooltip: Mirror tooltip position when main hand is left.
config.jade.mod_name.tooltip: The last line: the mod the target comes from.
config.jade.mod_name.translated.tooltip: Jade translates mod names through its language files; the port reads package names, so this option does nothing.
config.jade.distance.tooltip: Show the distance between the player and the target.
config.jade.coordinates.tooltip: Show the position of the target.
config.jade.block_face.tooltip: Show the face of the block the player touches.
config.jade.registry_name.special.toolti: Show special IDs like BlockEntity and Fluid. The port has no block-entity or fluid reads; this option does nothing.
config.jade.block_states.tooltip: The block's states, with Show Details held.
config.jade.block_properties.tooltip: Destroy time, explosion resistance and more, with Show Details held.
config.jade.harvest_tool.tooltip: The tools that mine the block, and whether yours harvests it.
config.jade.harvest_tool.creative.toolti: Show harvest information in creative or spectator mode as well
Show the check or cross for blocks any tool can harvest too.
config.jade.harvest_tool.new_line.toolti: Put the tool icons on a line of their own.
config.jade.harvest_tool.show_unbreakabl: Say when a block can't be broken.
config.jade.breaking_progress.tooltip: A bar along the box's bottom edge while you mine.
config.jade.redstone.tooltip: Levers, repeaters, comparators and powered blocks.
config.jade.hopper_lock.tooltip: Say when a hopper's inventory is locked. Port-only: Jade's lock line has no toggle.
config.jade.tnt_stability.tooltip: Warn player of special TNT that ignites when hit.
config.jade.furnace.tooltip: A furnace's, smoker's or blast furnace's items and progress.
config.jade.brewing_stand.tooltip: Blaze powder left and the brewing time.
config.jade.beehive.tooltip: Honey and bees in a hive or nest.
config.jade.mob_spawner.tooltip: The mob a spawner makes, in its name.
config.jade.campfire.tooltip: What cooks on it and how long is left.
config.jade.item_entity.tooltip: A dropped item's name and count. Port-only: Jade shows these always.
config.jade.item_storage.tooltip: What is inside chests, barrels, hoppers and other containers.
Icons in each row of a container's contents.
config.jade.item_storage.normal_amount.t: The amount of items to show when Show Details is not pressed.
config.jade.item_storage.detailed_amount: The amount of items to show when Show Details is pressed.
config.jade.item_storage.show_name_amoun: The maximum amount of items to show item names instead of just item icons.
config.jade.entity_health.tooltip: Hearts, or a number for very healthy mobs.
config.jade.entity_health.max_for_render: Above this much health, show a number instead of hearts.
config.jade.entity_health.show_fractions: Health as a decimal number, not rounded up.
Above this much armor, show a number instead of armor icons.
config.jade.villager_profession.tooltip: A villager's job, and its level.
config.jade.mob_growth.tooltip: Time until a baby grows up.
config.jade.mob_breeding.tooltip: In love, or time until it can breed again.
config.jade.horse_stats.tooltip: Jump height, speed and a llama's strength.
config.jade.armor_stand.tooltip: What an armor stand wears and holds.
config.jade.zombie_villager.tooltip: Time until a cured zombie villager converts.
config.jade.next_entity_drop.tooltip: Show the time until the next entity drop, such as egg or armadillo scute.
jade.config.title: Jade: Click to change, right-click to go back, Shift steps faster
